title: Chapter 344
text:
The ground shook.

The forest in the distance collapsed, and a huge beast slowly approached. Its body was close to two hundred meters long, and it was like a moving mountain. Even though they had seen the appearance of mountain beasts from the illustrated handbook, many of the mercenaries were still shocked at this moment.

"What a huge creature!"

The Mountain Beast had four hooves that were as thick as a building and a long tail that stood upright. Its body was covered in rock-like scales, and it had a thick yellow shell that looked like a tortoise shell on its back. Its head was like a shovel, and its jaw was protruding. Its eyes were hidden in the cracks of the shell, and the shape of its head gave off a ferocious feeling. However, the Mountain Beast was actually a gentler animal, and it liked to pretend to be a small mountain to sleep. It was affected by the Soul Tide that made it irritable.

Adult Mountain Beasts were usually between 150 to 220 meters in size. Compared to them, the Sunils were like ants on the ground.

The battleship in the sky fired at the Mountain Beast from afar. Six to seven electromagnetic railguns exploded on its body, shattering a large piece of rock armor but not hurting its flesh. The Mountain Beast's defense was extremely strong.

These few railguns angered it, and it let out a low roar like a cow. Its long tail stabbed into the ground with a bang, rolling up a large clump of soil mixed with trees. Its tail quickly tightened, and the clump of soil became much denser. Then, it swung its tail violently, and the clump of soil shot out like a cannonball. It contained the strength of a Mountain Beast, and its kinetic energy was extremely terrifying.

Han Xiao could not even see the full appearance of the flying clump of soil; he could only see a fleeting shadow.

Bang! The battleship's shield flickered, and the clump of soil exploded on it. With it as the center, chaotic electric current spread throughout the shield, and cracks quickly spread. This attack almost broke through the shield's defense. The battleship urgently increased its energy output, and the shield returned to its original state.

The attack did not work, so the Mountain Beast roared and rolled up another clump of soil. It could still use hundreds or thousands of attacks like this, but the battleship's energy was limited.

"High Energy Concentrated Particle Cannon charged. Target has entered shooting range. Countdown: Five, four, three, two, one … Fire!"

A dazzling milky white beam of light shot out. It was at least four meters in diameter and crossed a few thousand meters in the blink of an eye. It easily penetrated the Mountain Beast's shell and shot into its abdomen, causing a chain explosion inside its body.

Boom!

The sound of the explosion was like an earthquake!

A thick and solid beast's hoof was blasted away, and the front half of the mountain beast's body was blasted open. Blood flowed like a waterfall from the wound, and a miserable howl shook the heavens as it fell to the ground.

The High Energy Concentrated Particle Cannon was a weapon used by the battleships of a super high civilization. Being able to heavily injure a hundred-meter-long giant beast with just one shot was the trump card of the Sunil Race. This scene energized the soldiers. They suppressed their fatigue and fought against the beasts.

"What a terrifying weapon." Han Xiao's eyes lit up as he suppressed the desire in his heart. This was a weapon that could only be grasped at a later stage, and with his current level of knowledge, he was unable to learn it. Only by continuing to grow would he have the opportunity to create such a powerful weapon.

The particle cannon did not retract. Instead, it began to recharge. At this moment, the broadcast rang out once again. Not only was this mountain beast approaching, there were also two other powerful monsters approaching. Very soon, they appeared within their line of sight. One was a flying monster that looked like a dragon — a Lava Lizard. Its wingspan was a hundred meters, and its scales were ferocious. This thing was much harder to deal with than the Acid Flying Beetles of the same size. Not only was its shell tough, but it could also spit out lava. It lived in a volcanic environment.

The other was a land creature — a King Hunter. It looked like a tiger or a leopard, and its body was covered in armor-like scales. Its body was only about thirty meters long, but it was even more dangerous than the mountain beasts. It was agile and agile, and its movements were as fast as lightning. Therefore, it was difficult to lock onto it, unlike the mountain beasts, which were easy targets.

It could easily break through one line of defense after another, and its sharp claws could easily tear through metal. It was the biggest threat to the ground troops. The name King Hunter came from its dominance in the forest. It was the undisputed ruler of the forest on this planet. Every time it appeared, it meant that the Sunil Race had to pay a heavy price to deal with it. The most dangerous time was when a King Hunter almost broke through the defense circle and charged into the city.

The situation took a turn for the worse!

The Lava Lizard swooped down at high speed, and the King Hunter ran as fast as lightning. There were strong enemies approaching from both the sky and the ground, and there was even an injured mountain beast that kept throwing rocks. The particle cannon slowly finished charging. It aimed at the Lava Lizard in the sky and fired, directly breaking one of the Lava Lizard's wings. This monster spun and landed on the ground with a loud thud.

The enemies that could fly had to be dealt with first. The King Hunters on the ground could only be delayed by manpower, waiting for the particle cannon to recharge.

The army mobilized the troops in front of the King Hunter. There were more than a thousand people, but this number was not necessarily enough.

Endless bullets rained down, but they were all deflected by the scales of the King Hunter. Sparks flew everywhere. The King Hunter was getting faster and faster, and no attack could stop its momentum. Everyone could foresee the outcome if it crashed into the steel defense line at this speed. A bloody path would be plowed through the defense team, and they would lose at least two teams!

None of the soldiers wavered. They obeyed the orders without hesitation.

Just as the two sides were about to collide …

Boom!

Dust suddenly flew up, and the seemingly unstoppable King Hunter Beast actually stopped. It opened its bloody mouth wide and bit on a long grey metal cube that looked like a ruler. An armored warrior was holding onto the cube, and both sides were competing with each other in terms of strength. They were evenly matched.

It was this armored warrior that blocked the King Hunter, leaving only a majestic back view for all the soldiers!

Everyone opened their eyes wide, wanting to see who this intruder was. However, he was wearing a helmet, so they could not see his face at all. This armor was a little shabby, like a tight suit with a few pieces of armor embedded in it. The color was dark.

Seeing this, Han Xiao's lips curled up slightly.

The intruder was Herlous!

"You really came …" Han Technician smiled. "Let me see if you're strong enough at this time."

The King Hunter seemed to have sensed danger. It dodged to the side and roamed vigilantly. The defense team was about to surround it when Herlous suddenly said, "Leave this beast to me. You guys go somewhere else."

Leave it to you? Who are you? What if you fail?

The troops naturally did not dare to trust him so easily. However, before they could continue to move, they saw a strong Pugilist flame burst out of this armored warrior's body. Then, a change that shocked all the Sunils happened.

The shabby combat suit on Herlous suddenly changed shape. A few compressed pieces of armor opened up and turned into countless precise structures and armor. As the light flashed, the tight suit quickly turned into a set of extremely precise silver-blue armor, like a set of gorgeous ancient knight armor. A piece of pure white soft metal appeared on each of his shoulders and hung behind him like a cape. Even with Han Technician's extremely picky aesthetic, this design was very cool.

Energy surrounded the armor on his body. Herlous swung the rectangular piece in his hand, which expanded and turned into a mechanical battleship cutting blade that was almost ten meters long in the blink of an eye!

All the Sunils were shocked!

The name that was buried in their memories suddenly appeared. Countless soldiers opened their eyes wide and exclaimed in shock.

"This performance is … Commander Class armor?"

"The legendary race's strongest armor that has been lost!"

All the soldiers were shocked! Their minds went blank!

The Commander Class armor was an unattainable legend to the current Sunils, and the legend had truly appeared today!

Herlous twisted his neck. Strong Pugilist energy flowed throughout his body, and his dormant battle genes slowly awakened. This custom-made armor was working well, and it was in excellent condition. He chuckled.

"I've almost forgotten this feeling. This feeling … is not bad."

With a roar, Herlous waved the ten-meter-long battleship cutting blade and pounced forward. He was as fast as a phantom, and the thick blade flashed like a fountain!

Swoosh!

The blade slashed out a silver wave, creating a trench that was dozens of meters long. The King Hunter dodged it by a hair's breadth. A bloody wound appeared on its slender body, and the wound quickly expanded. Blood spurted out.

The roles of hunter and prey switched instantly!
